"""Identifiers. Internal ids are prefixed random hex; customer-facing codes avoid look-alike characters."""
import secrets

# No 0/O, 1/I/L: these codes get read out over the phone and typed from printed slips.
_CODE_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"


def new_id(prefix: str) -> str:
    """e.g. new_id("ord") -> "ord_3f9a1c2b7d4e"."""
    return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_hex(6)}"


def short_code(length: int = 8, groups: int = 0) -> str:
    """Random human-friendly code from an unambiguous alphabet, e.g. "K7QM-X2PA" with groups=4.
    groups=0 means no dashes."""
    code = "".join(secrets.choice(_CODE_ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))
    if groups:
        code = "-".join(code[i:i + groups] for i in range(0, len(code), groups))
    return code


def is_short_code(text: str) -> bool:
    return bool(text) and all(c in _CODE_ALPHABET or c == "-" for c in text)

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

from shopkit.utils.dates import utc_now

AUTHORIZED, CAPTURED, FAILED, VOIDED = "authorized", "captured", "failed", "voided"


@dataclass
class Payment:
    id: str
    order_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    currency: str
    method: str                      # card | paypal | gift_card
    status: str = AUTHORIZED
    card_number: str = ""            # stored redacted; see payments.reconciliation.redact_pan
    created: datetime = field(default_factory=utc_now)
    refunded_cents: int = 0

    @property
    def refundable_cents(self) -> int:
        return self.amount_cents - self.refunded_cents if self.status == CAPTURED else 0

"""Refunds against captured payments. Partial refunds are allowed up to the captured amount."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

from shopkit.errors import Conflict
from shopkit.money import format_money
from shopkit.payments.models import Payment
from shopkit.utils.dates import utc_now


class RefundTooLarge(Conflict):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Refund:
    payment_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    reason: str
    at: datetime = field(default_factory=utc_now)


def refund(payment: Payment, amount_cents: int, reason: str) -> Refund:
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        raise ValueError("refund amount must be positive")
    if amount_cents > payment.refundable_cents:
        raise RefundTooLarge(
            f"refund {format_money(amount_cents, payment.currency)} exceeds refundable "
            f"{format_money(payment.refundable_cents, payment.currency)}",
            payment_id=payment.id, requested=amount_cents, refundable=payment.refundable_cents)
    payment.refunded_cents += amount_cents
    return Refund(payment.id, amount_cents, reason)

"""Issue invoices for paid orders and credit notes for refunds, keeping both sequences gap-free."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.invoices import credit_notes
from shopkit.invoices.layout import footer, header
from shopkit.invoices.numbering import next_invoice_number
from shopkit.invoices.render import render_invoice_text
from shopkit.orders.models import Order


@dataclass
class IssuedInvoice:
    number: str
    order_id: str
    issued: date
    text: str


@dataclass
class InvoiceRegister:
    invoices: list[IssuedInvoice] = field(default_factory=list)
    credit_notes: list[credit_notes.CreditNote] = field(default_factory=list)

    def last_number(self) -> str | None:
        return self.invoices[-1].number if self.invoices else None

    def issue(self, order: Order, bill_to: Address, issued: date) -> IssuedInvoice:
        if any(i.order_id == order.id for i in self.invoices):
            raise ValueError(f"order {order.id} is already invoiced")
        number = next_invoice_number(self.last_number(), issued.year)
        text = "\n\n".join([header(number, issued, bill_to), render_invoice_text(order), footer()])
        invoice = IssuedInvoice(number, order.id, issued, text)
        self.invoices.append(invoice)
        return invoice

    def credit(self, order_id: str, refund_cents: int, currency: str, issued: date,
               reason: str) -> credit_notes.CreditNote:
        invoice = next(i for i in self.invoices if i.order_id == order_id)
        last = self.credit_notes[-1].number if self.credit_notes else None
        note = credit_notes.issue(last, invoice.number, refund_cents, currency, issued, reason)
        self.credit_notes.append(note)
        return note

"""Checkout: turns a cart into a priced order with tax, shipping and discounts, then takes payment."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

from shopkit.catalog.models import Product
from shopkit.catalog.pricing import PriceBook
from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.errors import ShopError
from shopkit.orders.models import Order, OrderLine
from shopkit.promotions.coupons import Coupon, discount_cents
from shopkit.shipping.rates import shipping_cents
from shopkit.tax.calculator import order_tax
from shopkit.utils.ids import new_id


class EmptyCart(ShopError):
    http_status = 422


class NotPurchasable(ShopError):
    http_status = 422


@dataclass
class Quote:
    order: Order
    subtotal_cents: int
    discount_cents: int
    shipping_cents: int
    tax_cents: int
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def total_cents(self) -> int:
        return self.subtotal_cents - self.discount_cents + self.shipping_cents + self.tax_cents


def quote(cart: dict[str, int], products: dict[str, Product], ship_to: Address, weight_g: int,
          prices: PriceBook, today: date, coupon: Coupon | None = None) -> Quote:
    """Price a cart (sku -> qty). Tax applies after discount on the goods; shipping is untaxed."""
    if not cart:
        raise EmptyCart("cart is empty")
    order = Order(id=new_id("ord"))
    for sku, qty in cart.items():
        product = products[sku]
        if not product.is_purchasable():
            raise NotPurchasable(f"{sku} is not available", sku=sku)
        order.lines.append(OrderLine(sku, qty, prices.unit_price(product, qty, today)))
    subtotal = order.total_cents
    discount = discount_cents(coupon, subtotal, today) if coupon else 0
    tax = order_tax(order, ship_to)
    if discount and subtotal:
        tax = tax * (subtotal - discount) // subtotal
    return Quote(order, subtotal, discount, shipping_cents(ship_to.country, weight_g, subtotal), tax)

"""Invoice header and footer blocks shared by the text and HTML invoice renderers."""
from datetime import date

from shopkit.config import SETTINGS
from shopkit.customers.addresses import format_address
from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.utils.dates import add_business_days

PAYMENT_TERMS_DAYS = 14
COMPANY = ["Shopkit Ltd", "1 Market Street", "Springfield, IL 62701", "US"]


def header(invoice_number: str, issued: date, bill_to: Address) -> str:
    due = add_business_days(issued, PAYMENT_TERMS_DAYS)
    parts = ["\n".join(COMPANY), "", f"Invoice number: {invoice_number}",
             f"Issued: {issued.isoformat()}   Due: {due.isoformat()}", "", "Bill to:",
             format_address(bill_to)]
    return "\n".join(parts)


def footer() -> str:
    return f"Questions? Contact {SETTINGS.support_email}. Thank you for your order."

"""Card gateway adapter. The real provider is behind `charge`; tests use FakeGateway."""
from shopkit.errors import ShopError
from shopkit.payments.models import AUTHORIZED, CAPTURED, FAILED, Payment
from shopkit.payments.reconciliation import redact_pan
from shopkit.utils.ids import new_id, short_code


class PaymentDeclined(ShopError):
    http_status = 402


def transfer_reference() -> str:
    """A fresh reference for bank-transfer payments: 12 chars, four per group, e.g. "K7Q2-PM8N-
    3HRD". Uses the same unambiguous alphabet as the shop's other customer-facing codes (no 0/O,
    1/I/L) so customers can copy or read it back."""
    return short_code(12, groups=4)


class FakeGateway:
    """Declines card numbers ending in 0000; everything else is authorized."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.payments: dict[str, Payment] = {}

    def authorize(self, order_id: str, amount_cents: int, currency: str, card_number: str) -> Payment:
        digits = "".join(c for c in card_number if c.isdigit())
        payment = Payment(new_id("pay"), order_id, amount_cents, currency, "card",
                          card_number=redact_pan(digits))
        if digits.endswith("0000"):
            payment.status = FAILED
            self.payments[payment.id] = payment
            raise PaymentDeclined("card declined", order_id=order_id, payment_id=payment.id)
        self.payments[payment.id] = payment
        return payment

    def capture(self, payment_id: str) -> Payment:
        payment = self.payments[payment_id]
        if payment.status != AUTHORIZED:
            raise ShopError(f"payment {payment_id} is {payment.status}", payment_id=payment_id)
        payment.status = CAPTURED
        return payment
